name: Wren's Garden
description: Old Wren the herbalist can't reach her garden. The Thornlings have opinions about that.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: You there, with the dragon! My herb garden is overrun. Thornlings, everywhere, being rude.
intro.name: Old Wren

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We'll clear a path.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *sniffs a Thornling, sneezes on it*

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Bog Hopper has claimed the garden pond. It is sitting on the mint.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Not the mint!
intro.name: Old Wren

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: My garden! Take these, dear. Potions taste better when the mint is fresh.
outro.name: Old Wren

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *eats a basil plant, looks very pleased with itself*

name: The Spore Cloud
description: A cloud of glowing spores is drifting toward the village. Wren wants a sample. So does everyone else.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Those Spore Puffers are making the whole Hollow sneeze. Bring me a jar of spores, would you?
intro.name: Old Wren

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: How hard can it be to catch a cloud?

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Two Moss Wisps zip in to guard the biggest Puffer. They glow menacingly. Mostly glow.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *tries to eat a wisp, gets a mouth full of light*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: You hold up a jar of glowing spores. They hum.

outro.speaker: rider
outro.text: Wren wanted these. But a trader in town pays good gold for glowing things.

choice.prompt: What do you do with the jar of spores?

options.label: Give the spores to Wren

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Oh, splendid! I'll brew something that makes dragons glow in the dark. Here, have some embers I found.
lines.name: Old Wren

options.label: Sell them in town

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The trader pays in shiny coins and asks no questions. Your dragon looks a little disappointed in you.

name: Elder of the Thicket
description: The oldest Thornling in the Hollow wants a word. A loud, pointy word.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Barkback Boar blocks the path to the thicket, chewing a log thoughtfully.

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Excuse us!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: It does not excuse you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: In the heart of the thicket, the Elder Thornling rises. It has a beard of twigs.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Who disturbs the thicket? The spore-thief and the sneezing lizard?
intro.name: Elder Thornling

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *sneezes, on purpose this time*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Fine. FINE. You are strong. The Troll beyond the brambles is stronger. Hah.
outro.name: Elder Thornling

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: It drops a lump of iron ore and stomps off, offended.

name: The Bramble Troll
description: The Bramble Troll has been hoarding the Hollow's sunshine. Time to share.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The Troll's brambles block the light. My herbs are wilting. So am I.
intro.name: Old Wren

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We're on it.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A pair of guards steps out of the brambles.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The brambles part. The Bramble Troll is sitting on a pile of stolen garden gnomes.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: MINE. All the gnomes. All the sun.
intro.name: Bramble Troll

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *growls in a way that is almost brave*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Sunlight floods the Hollow. Somewhere, a gnome is returned to a grateful garden.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: You've done it! The Hollow will sing about you. Badly, but with feeling.
outro.name: Old Wren

outro.speaker: rider
outro.text: Where to next, partner?

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *points its nose toward the sea*

name: Captain Pell's Boat
description: Captain Pell's boat is stuck on a sandbar. The crabs say it's theirs now.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Ahoy! My boat, the Soggy Biscuit, is surrounded by crabs. Very rude crabs.
intro.name: Captain Pell

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We've dealt with rude before.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Gull Bandit swoops down and steals Pell's hat.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: MY HAT!
intro.name: Captain Pell

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: You saved the Biscuit AND the hat. Here's something for your trouble.
outro.name: Captain Pell

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *tries on the hat. It does not fit.*

name: The Slime Tide
description: Brine Slimes are oozing up the beach at night. Pell thinks something is sending them.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Every night, more slime. Every morning, more mopping. I'm a captain, not a mop!
intro.name: Captain Pell

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Let's find where they come from.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The trail of slime leads into the kelp beds. Something large is wearing the kelp as a coat.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *pokes the kelp. The kelp pokes back.*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Behind the Kelp Lurker you find a chest, half-buried, with a map inside.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: That's the old salvage map! It shows a wreck full of gold. Or a lighthouse that needs help. The ink's smudged.
outro.name: Captain Pell

outro.speaker: rider
outro.text: Two marks. We can only reach one before the tide.

choice.prompt: The tide is coming in. Which mark do you follow?

options.label: Dig up the wreck's gold

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You find a soggy chest of coins. Your dragon guards it like it hatched it.

options.label: Help the lighthouse keeper

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Bless you! The light's been out for a week. Take these, they fell from the stars. Probably.
lines.name: Keeper Mae

name: The Shell Knight's Oath
description: A Shell Knight challenges you to an honorable duel. Its honor is mostly shell.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: HALT! I am Sir Clamsworth, Shell Knight of the Third Tide. I challenge thee!
intro.name: Sir Clamsworth

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Is this really necessary?

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: VERY.
intro.name: Sir Clamsworth

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Thou fightest well. But canst thou best my squire?
intro.name: Sir Clamsworth

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The squire is a crab. It is a very big crab. It is Big Pincher.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: I yield! Know this: the Crab King stirs in his tide pool. He has heard of thee. He is cross.
outro.name: Sir Clamsworth

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *clacks its jaws like a crab, badly*

name: The Crab King
description: The Crab King wants the whole shore. And Pell's boat. And, oddly, the hat.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: He's sent his whole court to the docks! Crabs, gulls, the lot.
intro.name: Captain Pell

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Then we go to him.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Crab King rises from his tide pool, crown gleaming, claws snapping.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Bow to the King of the Shore! Also give me that hat.
intro.name: Crab King

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: NEVER.
intro.name: Captain Pell

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The Crab King scuttles back into the sea, crownless and grumbling.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The shore is free! The Soggy Biscuit sails again!
outro.name: Captain Pell

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *stands at the front of the boat, very proud, gets splashed*

name: Lost in the Fog
description: Ferryman Bo has lost his way in his own marsh. That has never happened before. He says.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Ahoy, keeper! The fog rolled in thick and now every reed looks like every other reed.
intro.name: Ferryman Bo

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We'll find the channel. Stay close.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Something giggles in the mud.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A lantern bobs over the water, whispering. It says your name. It says it wrong.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *snaps at the lantern, misses, sulks*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The channel! I knew where it was the whole time. Mostly. Here, for your trouble.
outro.name: Ferryman Bo

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Bo's raft is held together with string and optimism.

name: The Whispering Lights
description: The wisps are leading travelers into the deep marsh. Bo wants to know why.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Three travelers this week, all following lights into the bog. All came back muddy and grumpy.
intro.name: Ferryman Bo

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Let's follow the lights ourselves.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The lights lead to a clearing. A Reed Stalker stands very still, pretending to be a reed.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *sniffs the reed. The reed sneezes.*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Behind the Reed Stalker the wisps gather around a cracked lantern, flickering and lost.

outro.speaker: rider
outro.text: They're not leading people astray. They're lost too.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: You could carry the lantern back to Bo. Or set it on the old stone shrine, where the wisps used to rest.

choice.prompt: What do you do with the cracked lantern?

options.label: Return it to the shrine

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The wisps settle into the shrine with a happy hum. One of them drops a glowing crystal at your feet.

options.label: Sell it to Bo

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A real wisp lantern! Collectors pay a fortune for these. Well, a small fortune. Here.
lines.name: Ferryman Bo

name: Toad Trouble
description: The Murk Toads are singing all night. The whole Fen wants to sleep.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: RIBBIT. RIBBIT. All night! I haven't slept since Tuesday!
intro.name: Ferryman Bo

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Which Tuesday?

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I don't know anymore!
intro.name: Ferryman Bo

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The choir's conductor appears: a Lily Snapper with a very small baton.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *tries to eat the baton*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The toads fall silent. A huge croak rolls across the marsh from somewhere deeper in.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: That... that's Old Croaker. The toads only sing when she's cranky.
outro.name: Ferryman Bo

name: Old Croaker's Pond
description: Old Croaker is cranky because something is draining her pond. She thinks it's you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The pond is half empty. Bogling footprints lead everywhere.

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Someone's been digging channels.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: WHO drains my pond? Was it you? It smells like you.
intro.name: Old Croaker

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: It wasn't us! But we'll prove it.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Prove it by losing!
intro.name: Old Croaker

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Hmph. You fight like you've got nothing to hide. The water's flowing to the old willow. It's always the willow.
outro.name: Old Croaker

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Old Croaker gives you a smooth stone. It's warm, and it smells like pond.

choice.prompt: The Boglings dug the channels to water their mushroom farm. What now?

options.label: Help them share the water

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You dig one more channel, so the pond and the farm both get some. The Boglings give you a basket of mushrooms and a very muddy hug.

options.label: Fill in the channels

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Ha! My pond! You're all right, keeper.
lines.name: Old Croaker

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Boglings glare at you from the reeds.

name: The Whisperwillow
description: At the heart of the Fen, an ancient willow drinks the marsh dry and whispers about it.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I'll row you to the heart of the Fen. I'll also row away very fast afterwards.
intro.name: Ferryman Bo

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The guards of the willow rise out of the reeds.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Whisperwillow towers over a dry, cracked pond. Its branches hiss.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Thirsty. Always thirsty. The marsh is MINE to drink.
intro.name: Whisperwillow

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *growls, then whispers back, which confuses everyone*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The willow's roots let go. Water rushes back into the ponds and channels of the Fen.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Fine. I'll share. But I'm going to complain about it.
outro.name: Whisperwillow

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The fog's lifting! I can see my house! I can see... three of my houses? Oh, that's just the one, it's very long.
outro.name: Ferryman Bo

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *splashes in the new puddles, completely delighted*

name: The Archivist
description: A gnome historian is studying the ruins. The ruins are studying her back.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Oh, splendid, a dragon keeper! I'm Odd. Archivist Odd. I'm cataloguing the fortress, and the fortress keeps trying to catalogue me.
intro.name: Archivist Odd

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We'll keep the machines off you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Cog Crawler ticks out of a crack in the wall.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: That one's a Brass Sentry. Model seven. Very polite. Very stabby.
intro.name: Archivist Odd

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *sniffs the sentry, gets a static shock, sulks*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Marvelous! Three hundred years and they still work. Mostly. Here, a little something from my research budget.
outro.name: Archivist Odd

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Odd writes 'keeper: useful' in a very small notebook.

name: Steam and Whistles
description: The old boiler room is whistling again. Odd wants to know why. So does everyone's ears.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The boilers haven't run in centuries, and yet... listen.
intro.name: Archivist Odd

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: WHEEEEEEE. A Boiler Bot waddles out, whistling furiously.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Behind it, a Spark Hound guards the boiler room door, wagging its tail so hard sparks fly.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *wags back, confused but happy*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Inside, the old furnace is lit. Someone has been feeding it coal.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Fascinating. Something in the fortress is waking up, and it's hungry for fire.
outro.name: Archivist Odd

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: A crate of spare coal sits by the door. Odd's eyes light up. So do the Spark Hounds'.

choice.prompt: The crate of coal: who gets it?

options.label: Feed it to the Spark Hounds

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Spark Hounds crunch the coal happily and follow you around for a bit. One leaves you a shiny scale it found.

options.label: Give it to Odd for her research

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: For science! And also for heating my tea. Take this, I won't need it anymore.
lines.name: Archivist Odd

name: Gargoyle Watch
description: The gargoyles on the walls have started waking up. One at a time. Grumpily.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The gargoyles were carved to wake if the fortress was in danger. So... is it?
intro.name: Archivist Odd

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Gargoyle Pup yawns, stretches, and notices you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Two more pups drop from the battlements. They look extremely awake now.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *does its best gargoyle impression, perfectly still, fooling no one*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The gargoyles only wake when the captain sounds the alarm. And the captain... oh dear. The captain.
outro.name: Archivist Odd

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: A distant bell rings, slightly off-key.

name: Captain Clank
description: The fortress captain has woken up and has orders to follow. Very, very old orders.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: He's in the great hall, rallying the guard. Do be careful, he's very formal about stabbing.
intro.name: Archivist Odd

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A squad of Brass Sentries forms up in the hall.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: HALT! Intruders in the fortress! By order of the King, who is... where is the King?
intro.name: Captain Clank

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: The King's been gone for 300 years, Captain.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Then I shall defend the fortress until he returns! EN GARDE!
intro.name: Captain Clank

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: You fight with honor. The fortress... has no king? Then whom do I serve?
outro.name: Captain Clank

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Perhaps yourself, Captain? Or perhaps a nice museum?
outro.name: Archivist Odd

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: A museum. I... would like that. Beware the Colossus below. Its furnace has been lit.
outro.name: Captain Clank

choice.prompt: Captain Clank needs a new purpose. What do you suggest?

options.label: Guard Odd's new museum

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A museum guard! I shall salute every visitor. Twice.
lines.name: Captain Clank

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Free security! You're a genius, keeper.
lines.name: Archivist Odd

options.label: Train with you at the Roost

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A sparring partner for your dragon! I accept. I shall be gentle. I shall not be gentle.
lines.name: Captain Clank

lines.speaker: dragon
lines.text: *looks thrilled and slightly worried*

name: The Cinderforge Colossus
description: Deep under the ruins, the fortress's last guardian has stoked its furnace. It wants to rebuild the walls. With you inside them.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The forge hall. The Colossus is down there. I'll be up here. Taking notes. From a distance.
intro.name: Archivist Odd

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The forge's guard hounds come bounding up the stairs.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Cinderforge Colossus rises from the forge, stone hands glowing, furnace roaring in its chest.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: WALLS. MUST. BE. REBUILT.
intro.name: Cinderforge Colossus

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *growls at the heat, then sneezes a puff of smoke back at it*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The Colossus's furnace sputters out with a long, tired sigh. It sits down, very gently, and goes back to sleep.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: History made! And written down! Mostly legible!
outro.name: Archivist Odd

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The fortress is at peace. Museum hours begin at nine.
outro.name: Captain Clank

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *curls up next to the warm forge, very pleased*

name: The Lamplighter
description: Someone keeps blowing out the lanterns in Moonwell Woods. Lamplighter Nell is not amused.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Every lantern I light, something puffs it out! Every single one!
intro.name: Lamplighter Nell

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We'll keep watch while you work.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Two big round eyes blink in the dark. Hoo.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Frostcap Shroom sits on the lantern post, glowing smugly.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: That's not a lantern. That's a mushroom pretending to be a lantern.
intro.name: Lamplighter Nell

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *bonks the mushroom, gets bonked back*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The path is lit! Thank you, keeper. Here, take some lamp money. Don't spend it all on lamps.
outro.name: Lamplighter Nell

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The lanterns flicker on, one by one, down the long dark path.

name: Gossip in the Trees
description: The trees are spreading rumors about you. Some of them are even true.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The trees have been talking. They say you snore. They say your dragon eats lanterns.
intro.name: Lamplighter Nell

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *quietly hides a lantern behind its back*

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Snickerbark giggles from behind a log.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The rumor trail leads to a ring of Snickerbarks telling spooky stories around a cold blue fire.

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: That's where the gossip starts.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The Snickerbarks huddle together, giggling nervously.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Okay, okay! We'll stop! But only if you tell us a scary story first. A good one.
outro.name: Snickerbark

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: They're not bad, just bored. And loud.
outro.name: Lamplighter Nell

choice.prompt: The Snickerbarks want a scary story. What do you tell them?

options.label: Tell them a truly scary story

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your story is so scary the Snickerbarks hide under their own roots for a week. One of them leaves you a shiny scale as a peace offering.

options.label: Tell them a funny one instead

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Snickerbarks laugh so hard their leaves fall off. They promise to gossip only nice things from now on.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Nice gossip! Imagine that.
lines.name: Lamplighter Nell

name: The Sock Thief
description: Every camper's socks are missing. Nell suspects the foxes. Nell suspects everyone.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I put my socks by the fire. In the morning? Gone. All of them. Even the itchy ones.
intro.name: Lamplighter Nell

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Shadow Fox trots past with a striped sock in its mouth.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The fox leads you to a burrow. A Rimeback Badger is sitting on a huge pile of socks, looking extremely guilty.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *sniffs the pile, sneezes, looks offended*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The badger has been using the socks to stay warm all winter. It looks very cold now.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Oh, you poor thing. Fine. You can keep the itchy ones.
outro.name: Lamplighter Nell

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Under the socks: a little stash of iron ore and a very old lantern.

name: The Great Stag
description: Duskhorn, the stag who guards the moonwell, has stopped letting anyone near it.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Duskhorn always lets travelers drink from the moonwell. Now he charges anyone who tries.
intro.name: Lamplighter Nell

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The forest guards the path: owls in the branches, mushrooms in the roots.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Duskhorn steps out of the mist, stars caught in his antlers, eyes cold.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The well is not safe. Something sleeps in it that should not wake. Turn back.
intro.name: Duskhorn

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Then let us help.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: You are strong. Perhaps strong enough. The Wyrm in the well has been stealing the forest's dreams. That is why the trees gossip and the foxes steal. Nobody sleeps.
outro.name: Duskhorn

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: No wonder I've been so tired!
outro.name: Lamplighter Nell

choice.prompt: Duskhorn offers you a gift for the road. Which do you take?

options.label: A star from his antlers

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Carry it into the dark. It will not go out.
lines.name: Duskhorn

options.label: His blessing for your dragon

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Duskhorn touches his nose to your dragon's. Your dragon stands a little taller, and very still, and very proud.

name: The Moonwell Wyrm
description: Deep in the moonwell sleeps a serpent of night sky, and it has been eating everyone's dreams.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I'll light the way to the well. After that, you're on your own. I'll be over here. Holding a lantern. Supportively.
intro.name: Lamplighter Nell

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The well's last guards slip out of the shadows.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The moonwell glows. The water rises, and rises, and becomes a long serpent made of stars.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Sssleep. Dream for me. I'm ssso hungry for dreams.
intro.name: Moonwell Wyrm

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *yawns, then shakes it off and growls*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The Moonwell Wyrm sinks back into the water, full and drowsy, and lets the stolen dreams drift up like fireflies.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Look! They're going home. Every dream in the forest.
outro.name: Lamplighter Nell

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The woods will sleep tonight. Thank you, keeper.
outro.name: Duskhorn

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *falls asleep on the spot and snores, very loudly*

name: The Prospector
description: Prospector Goldie has a treasure map, a shovel, and a lot of sand in her boots.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Howdy! You look like someone who can carry heavy treasure. Or fight things that sit on heavy treasure.
intro.name: Prospector Goldie

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Mostly the second one.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Sand Scarab rolls a huge golden ball straight at you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Something shimmers on the dune ahead. A jackal. Two jackals? No, one jackal and a mirage of a jackal.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *bites the mirage, gets a mouthful of sand*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Ha! That's the spirit! Here's your cut of nothing, since we haven't found anything yet. Kidding. Here.
outro.name: Prospector Goldie

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Goldie hands you a pouch of coins. Some of them are real.

name: Mirage Trouble
description: Goldie keeps digging up treasure that turns out to be mirages. Something is playing tricks.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Third chest today that vanished when I opened it! I'm starting to take it personally.
intro.name: Prospector Goldie

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Glimmer Lizard suns itself on a rock, glowing so bright the air shimmers.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The shimmer clears. A real chest sits in the sand. It has teeth.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Oh, come ON.
intro.name: Prospector Goldie

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *growls at the chest. The chest growls back.*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: When the mimic stops chomping, it spits out a little pile of real gold and a strange map piece.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: A map to the Sunken Vault! Folks say it's guarded by a sphinx. Folks also say I talk too much.
outro.name: Prospector Goldie

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The mimic sulks. It liked that gold.

choice.prompt: The mimic looks sad without its gold. What do you do?

options.label: Keep the gold

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Finders keepers! Well. Fighters keepers.
lines.name: Prospector Goldie

options.label: Toss the mimic a few coins back

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The mimic snaps up the coins and wags its lid like a happy dog. It coughs up a glittering crystal it had been saving.

name: The Buried Gate
description: The map leads to a gate half-buried in sand, guarded by statues that are not as still as statues should be.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: There! The gate! And there! The guards. And there... is that one blinking?
intro.name: Prospector Goldie

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Dune Sentinel grinds to life, sand pouring from its shoulders.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: More sentinels wake along the gate. And a Sand Scarab, who seems to be their supervisor.

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *digs furiously at the sand, mostly getting it in everyone's face*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The gate creaks open. Beyond it, a long stair leads down into golden light.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The Sunken Vault. My grandmother looked for this her whole life. She'd be so jealous.
outro.name: Prospector Goldie

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: A voice echoes up the stairs. 'Who walks my stair without a riddle?'

name: The Riddle Sphinx
description: The Riddle Sphinx guards the vault with riddles. She asks them very fast and attacks immediately after.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The stair is lined with jackals and lizards, all waiting for the sphinx's show.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Remind me why we're doing this?
intro.name: Prospector Goldie

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Treasure.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: What walks on four legs, flies on two wings, and is about to lose? Too slow! It's your dragon!
intro.name: Riddle Sphinx

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *looks deeply offended*

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: That's not even a riddle!

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Fine, fine. You may pass. But the Basilisk below will turn you to gold, and then I shall use you as a doorstop.
outro.name: Riddle Sphinx

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: She's not wrong about the Basilisk. Its gaze turns things to gold. My grandmother's hat is down there. Solid gold.
outro.name: Prospector Goldie

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The sphinx sulks, and offers one last riddle as a gift.

choice.prompt: The sphinx offers a riddle. Answer it, or ask her a riddle back?

options.label: Answer her riddle

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Correct! Nobody ever gets that one. Take this, clever one.
lines.name: Riddle Sphinx

options.label: Ask her one back

lines.speaker: rider
lines.text: What has a mane, two wings, and talks too much?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: ...I don't like this riddle. Take your prize and go.
lines.name: Riddle Sphinx

lines.speaker: dragon
lines.text: *snickers*

name: The Aurum Basilisk
description: In the heart of the Sunken Vault coils the Aurum Basilisk, guarding a hoard it has turned to gold one adventurer at a time.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Golden statues everywhere. Hope none of them are folks I know. Ooh, that one's my grandmother's hat!
intro.name: Prospector Goldie

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The vault's last guardians rise from the treasure piles.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Aurum Basilisk uncoils from a mountain of gold, eyes blazing like twin suns.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: More gold for the hoard. Look at me. LOOK at me.
intro.name: Aurum Basilisk

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Don't look at it!

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *squeezes its eyes shut and charges anyway*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The Basilisk's glow fades. All around the vault, golden statues crack, and adventurers step out, blinking and confused.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Grandma?!
outro.name: Prospector Goldie

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Goldie? You got old! Where's my hat?
outro.name: Grandma Goldie

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Somewhere far beyond the peak, past the edge of every map, a drowned city waits.

name: Falling Stars
description: Stars keep falling into the hollow, and Stargazer Pell wants to count every one. Something keeps eating them.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Forty-one, forty-two... hey! That one was mine! Something just ran off with it!
intro.name: Stargazer Pell

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: We'll get it back.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A small hedgehog trundles past, its quills glittering with stolen stardust.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A cloud of pale moths drifts toward the glowing crystals, wings dusted with frost.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Moths. Of course it's moths. They love a bright light.
intro.name: Stargazer Pell

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *glows a little brighter, just to be helpful*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Forty-three! The count is right again. You have no idea how much that matters to me.
outro.name: Stargazer Pell

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Pell writes the number in a tiny book full of tiny numbers.

name: The Lost Comet
description: A comet came down last night and a whole litter of Comet Pups came with it. One of them is very lost.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Comet Pups! They're harmless. Mostly. Don't let them yip at you, it takes your words away.
intro.name: Stargazer Pell

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Comet Pup skids around a crystal, tail blazing.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The smallest pup hides behind an Astral Owlet, which glares at you as if it's all your fault.

choice.prompt: The smallest Comet Pup won't stop following you. What do you do?

options.label: Walk it back to its litter

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You find the litter curled around a warm crater. The pup's mother licks it all over, then licks you too.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You're sticky. That means she likes you.
lines.name: Stargazer Pell

options.label: Race it to the top of the hill

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The pup wins, easily, and leaves a trail of stardust you can scoop up. Your dragon sulks the whole way down.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: That's every pup accounted for. I counted them. Twice.
outro.name: Stargazer Pell

name: Glass and Frost
description: The Glass Golems have started freezing Pell's telescope shut. Science is under attack.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: My telescope is a block of ice. A block! How am I meant to count stars through ice?
intro.name: Stargazer Pell

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Glass Golem stands guard over the frozen telescope, looking pleased with itself.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Another golem lumbers in, with a frost moth riding on its head like a hat.

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *breathes very gently on the telescope until it thaws*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Perfect. Not a scratch. You may call me Pell. Everyone does, but now you may.
outro.name: Stargazer Pell

name: The Prism Stag
description: The Prism Stag has been splitting starlight into rainbows all over the valley. It's very pretty, and very hard to count.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Rainbows dance across the snow. A Shardling and an Astral Owlet chase them in circles.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: On the ridge stands the Prism Stag, antlers blazing with color.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Behold! Am I not the most beautiful thing in the sky?
intro.name: Prism Stag

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: It's on the ground. It's standing on the ground.
intro.name: Stargazer Pell

choice.prompt: The Prism Stag offers you a chip of its antler, if you say it's beautiful.

options.label: Tell it it's beautiful

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: I know. But it's nice to hear.
lines.name: Prism Stag

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It drops a glittering chip of antler at your feet.

options.label: Tell it the rainbows are a nuisance

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The stag gasps. Then it thinks about it, and dims its antlers a little. Pell cries with joy and pays you in coins.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The rainbows are gone. I can count again. Only one thing left in this valley that I can't count past.
outro.name: Stargazer Pell

name: The Starwarden
description: Every fallen star in the hollow belongs to the Starwarden, it says. Including the ones Pell is counting.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: It lives at the top of the valley. It hoards the stars. It says counting them is stealing. I say it's science.
intro.name: Stargazer Pell

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Comet Pup and a Glass Golem block the path up the hill.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A huge owl-griffin unfolds from the crystals, eyes like two pale moons.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Who counts MY stars? Nobody counts my stars but me!
intro.name: Starwarden

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *puffs up to look as big as possible*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The Starwarden folds its wings and grumbles.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Fine. You may count them. But I get to check your sums.
outro.name: Starwarden

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: A partner! I've always wanted a counting partner.
outro.name: Stargazer Pell

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *yawns and lies down in the snow*

name: The Edge of the Map
description: Cartographer Wren is drawing a map of the Voidmarch. The trouble is, bits of it keep disappearing.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I drew that rock this morning. Now look. It's gone! Where does a rock go?
intro.name: Cartographer Wren

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Into the void, I'd guess.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A small Rift Mite scuttles past with a pebble disappearing into its back.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Shardhorn Goat stands on the next ledge, rocks spinning lazily around its horns.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: That goat has been eating my landmarks.
intro.name: Cartographer Wren

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *snorts at the goat; the goat snorts back*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Hold still, everything. Thank you. There. A map! Mostly.
outro.name: Cartographer Wren

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Wren inks a big empty circle in the middle of the page and labels it 'Here Be Nothing'.

name: The Hungry Dark
description: Gloom Gulpers have been swallowing Wren's lantern light. All of it.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: My lantern was full of light. Then a blob floated by and now it's full of dark.
intro.name: Cartographer Wren

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Gloom Gulper bobs in the air, glowing very slightly from the inside.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Two more come drifting out of the chasm, one riding on a Rift Mite.

choice.prompt: The last Gloom Gulper hiccups out a little ball of stolen light. What do you do with it?

options.label: Put it back in Wren's lantern

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Oh, it's warm! It's the warmest light I've ever had.
lines.name: Cartographer Wren

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Wren pays you well, and hums all the way back to camp.

options.label: Let your dragon swallow it

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your dragon gulps it down and glows from the inside for an hour. It looks very pleased with itself.

lines.speaker: dragon
lines.text: *hic*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The dark is just dark again. Normal dark. I can work with normal dark.
outro.name: Cartographer Wren

name: The Boulder Crabs
description: The Rubble Crabs are carrying the cliffs away one boulder at a time. Wren's map is getting shorter.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Those crabs are stealing the cliffs! I just drew those cliffs!
intro.name: Cartographer Wren

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Rubble Crab scuttles sideways, a whole boulder floating above its back.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: An Echo Bat swoops down to help the crab with its boulder, ears flapping.

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *pushes the boulder back into place with its nose*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Perfect. Cliffs restored. You'd make a fine cartographer's assistant. The pay is terrible.
outro.name: Cartographer Wren

name: The Voidstrider
description: Something tall walks the edge of the chasm every night, very slowly. Wren wants it on the map.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Echo Bats and Shardhorn Goats scatter as you climb the ridge.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A tall stone heron steps out of the mist, one slow leg at a time. Where its heart should be, there's a window of nothing.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: You are... in... my... way.
intro.name: Voidstrider

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: It talks! It talks very slowly!
intro.name: Cartographer Wren

choice.prompt: The Voidstrider offers to show Wren the safest path across the chasm, if she leaves it off her map.

options.label: Keep its secret

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Thank... you.
lines.name: Voidstrider

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It drops a stone feather and walks off into the mist, very slowly.

options.label: Put it on the map anyway

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Science waits for no heron!
lines.name: Cartographer Wren

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Wren draws it in great detail. Tall, grumpy, slow. The map sells for a fortune.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: One thing left on my list. The big empty circle in the middle. Something lives in it.
outro.name: Cartographer Wren

name: The Nullmaw
description: At the bottom of the Voidmarch sits a stone toad with a hole in the world for a belly. It wants Wren's map. It wants everything.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I'll wait up here. Someone has to finish the map if, you know. If.
intro.name: Cartographer Wren

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Gloom Gulper and a Rubble Crab guard the last ledge.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The ground rumbles. A huge stone toad rises from the chasm, and its belly is a swirling hole of nothing.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Hungry. HUNGRY. Give me the map. Give me the sky. Give me your little dragon.
intro.name: Nullmaw

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *growls and plants its feet*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The Nullmaw slumps back into the chasm and lets out an enormous burp. Three rocks, a lantern's worth of light and a very confused goat come floating back out.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: My landmarks! You found my landmarks!
outro.name: Cartographer Wren

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *sniffs the goat; the goat sniffs back*

name: The Last Harbor
description: Past the peak, one old harbormaster still keeps watch over a city that sank long ago.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Visitors! Nobody's come over the peak in forty years. Mind the eels.
intro.name: Harbormaster Quill

intro.speaker: rider
intro.text: Eels?

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A lantern bobs toward you in the water. There's an eel under it.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Storm Gull lands on the pier and steals Quill's sandwich.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Not again! That's the third one today!
intro.name: Harbormaster Quill

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *eyes the gull, then the sandwich*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Forty years, and you're the first to get my sandwich back. Here, you've earned this.
outro.name: Harbormaster Quill

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: Quill hands over a purse of old coins, still a little damp.

name: The Sunken Gate
description: The old city gate is still guarded. The guards just haven't noticed it's underwater.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: The Drowned Sentries still guard the gate. Loyal to the end. Well, past the end.
intro.name: Harbormaster Quill

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Drowned Sentry turns its mossy helmet toward you with a grinding creak.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Barnacle Brute lumbers out of the water to help, dripping on everything.

choice.prompt: The last Sentry kneels and offers you the key to the drowned gate.

options.label: Keep the key

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's heavy, rusty, and covered in barnacles. Quill buys it from you for a lot of gold, then hangs it over the door.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: A piece of history!
lines.name: Harbormaster Quill

options.label: Tell the Sentry it can rest now

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Sentry nods slowly, lays down its spear, and sinks gently into the sand. A pearl rolls out of its helmet.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The gate's open. First time in a century. Mind your step, it's slippery.
outro.name: Harbormaster Quill

name: Squall Season
description: The Squall Sprites have rained on Quill's washing for the last time.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Every time I hang out my washing, it rains. On the washing. Only on the washing.
intro.name: Harbormaster Quill

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A small grumpy cloud floats over the line and starts drizzling.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Two more clouds and a Reef Stalker join in, which seems unnecessary.

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *breathes a warm puff over the washing until it's dry*

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Dry socks. You have no idea what that means to a harbormaster.
outro.name: Harbormaster Quill

name: The Thunder Ray
description: When it storms, a great ray swims through the sky over the spires. It's been knocking the roofs off.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Lightning flashes. Storm Gulls and Barnacle Brutes scatter across the plaza.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Something huge glides out of the clouds, wings crackling with lightning.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: That's it! That's the roof-knocker!
intro.name: Harbormaster Quill

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *flattens its ears, then spreads its wings*

choice.prompt: The Thunder Ray circles low, tired. It only wants a dry place to rest when the storm is worst.

options.label: Offer it the old lighthouse

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ray settles on the lighthouse roof and folds its wings. The light flickers on for the first time in years.

options.label: Chase it out to sea

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You chase it far out over the waves. It drops something shiny as it goes.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Roofs stay on now. Mostly. Now there's only one more thing out there. The big one.
outro.name: Harbormaster Quill

name: The Tidelord
description: The king of the drowned city wakes once a century to collect his taxes. He's early.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: He wants tax. From a city that sank. I told him we're all out of everything.
intro.name: Harbormaster Quill

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Reef Stalker and a Drowned Sentry rise from the water to escort you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The sea rises in a great swell, and a sea serpent wearing a coral crown rises with it.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Who dares walk MY plaza without bowing?
intro.name: Tidelord

intro.speaker: dragon
intro.text: *bows, a very small amount, then growls*

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The Tidelord sinks back beneath the waves, crown askew.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Fine. No tax this century. But I'll be back.
outro.name: Tidelord

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: A hundred years! That's plenty of time to save up.
outro.name: Harbormaster Quill

outro.speaker: dragon
outro.text: *shakes off a whole bucket of seawater onto Quill*

name: The Sick Wood
description: Something is rotting the trees in the thicket. Herbalist Moss wants to know what.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Every tree in here is sick. Every single one. I've been making tea for them, but trees don't drink tea.
intro.name: Herbalist Moss

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A fat grub wriggles out of a tree, munching happily on the rot.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Watch the vines. They move when you're not looking.
intro.name: Herbalist Moss

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A tangle of thorny vine stands up and shuffles toward you.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Two less pests. The trees look a little less sad already. Here, for your trouble.
outro.name: Herbalist Moss

name: Spore Season
description: The Spore Toads are puffing their spores all over Moss's herb garden.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: My garden! My lovely garden! It's all fuzzy now!
intro.name: Herbalist Moss

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A toad puffs its cheeks, and a cloud of spores drifts out behind it.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Gloomcap Walker stomps in to join the fun.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The garden will grow back. It always does. You two, though, could use a bath.
outro.name: Herbalist Moss

choice.prompt: The last Spore Toad looks at you with big sorry eyes. It just wants somewhere damp to live.

options.label: Find it a pond far from the garden

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It hops into a quiet pond and blows one happy little bubble. Moss gives you a jar of her best salve.

options.label: Shoo it off into the swamp

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It hops off in a huff, leaving a trail of spores and something shiny.

name: The Patient Croc
description: A Mire Lurker has been lying across the only path through the thicket for nine years.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: It doesn't do anything. It just lies there. Waiting. Nine years!
intro.name: Herbalist Moss

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The crocodile opens one eye. Then the other. Then its mouth.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Vines rise out of the water around it.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The path is clear for the first time since I was a girl. Well. Since I was a younger lady.
outro.name: Herbalist Moss

name: The Rotwood Ent
description: The biggest tree outside the Queen herself has started walking. It is not in a good mood.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Mushrooms and grubs scatter as the ground shakes.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Who... has been... pruning... MY branches?
intro.name: Rotwood Ent

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A tree three times your height pulls its roots out of the mud and turns around.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: It sat back down. That's good. Trees should sit down. Now only the Queen is left.
outro.name: Herbalist Moss

choice.prompt: The Rotwood Ent asks you to cut away its sickest branch.

options.label: Cut it away gently

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Ent sighs with relief and drops a heavy, healthy acorn into your hands.

options.label: Cut it and sell the wood

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Rotwood fetches a strange price at market. Moss doesn't ask who buys it.

name: The Rotroot Queen
description: At the heart of the thicket stands the tree where the rot began. She is awake.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I'll stay here and brew something strong. You go and be brave. Bravely. Away from me.
intro.name: Herbalist Moss

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The last guards of the heart of the wood rise from the mud.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Who dares... walk... in MY wood?
intro.name: Rotroot Queen

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The ground cracks. A huge hollow tree drags herself up on her roots, eyes glowing sickly yellow.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The Queen settles back into the earth. Her leaves turn green, one by one. Moss cries a little, and pretends it's the spores.
outro.name: Herbalist Moss

name: The Burning Path
description: Ranger Ashby keeps a trail through the volcanic jungle. Something keeps setting it on fire.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: My trail's on fire. Again. Third time this week.
intro.name: Ranger Ashby

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A monkey with a burning tail swings past, giggling.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A parrot lands on a branch and shouts something very rude.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Trail's safe. For today. Come back tomorrow, it'll be on fire again.
outro.name: Ranger Ashby

name: The Hungry Garden
description: Ashby's camp is surrounded by Flame Lilies. They are growing closer every night.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: They were six feet away yesterday. Today they're four. I'm not sleeping well.
intro.name: Ranger Ashby

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Flame Lily turns its petals toward you and opens its mouth.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A raptor bursts out of the ferns behind it.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The camp's safe. I'm moving it anyway.
outro.name: Ranger Ashby

choice.prompt: One small Flame Lily is left, curled up and scared.

options.label: Pot it and give it to Ashby

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ashby names it Petal and feeds it bugs. She seems pleased. So does Petal.

options.label: Take its seeds for the Forge

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The seeds glow like coals. They'll make good fuel.

name: The Slow Road
description: A Magma Tortoise has stopped in the middle of the only bridge. It might move in a hundred years.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I've asked it nicely. I've asked it rudely. It just blinks.
intro.name: Ranger Ashby

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The tortoise blinks. Slowly.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A monkey hops on its shell and starts throwing embers.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Bridge is clear. The tortoise found somewhere warmer to sit.
outro.name: Ranger Ashby

name: King of the Canopy
description: The Vine Tyrant has declared the whole jungle his. Including Ashby.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The canopy rustles as his loyal subjects come to meet you.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Bow before the KING of the CANOPY!
intro.name: Vine Tyrant

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A great gorilla wrapped in vines drops down from the trees and beats his chest.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: He'll be fine. He's just a bit full of himself. Now, about that volcano.
outro.name: Ranger Ashby

choice.prompt: The Vine Tyrant offers you a place in his court.

options.label: Accept, politely

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: He gives you a crown of leaves. It's itchy, but it's the thought that counts.

options.label: Tell him there's only one king here, and it's your dragon

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your dragon roars. The Tyrant bows. Ashby laughs for a full minute.

name: The Volcanadon
description: At the heart of Emberwild walks a dinosaur with a volcano on its back. It erupts when it gets cross, and it is always cross.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I'll be at camp. With the buckets. Lots of buckets.
intro.name: Ranger Ashby

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The ground shakes. Lava trickles past your feet.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: RRRAAAWR!
intro.name: Volcanadon

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A huge armored dinosaur stomps out of the smoke, the volcano on its back rumbling.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The Volcanadon lies down in a river and cools off with a long hiss of steam. For the first time in years, Emberwild is quiet.
outro.name: Ranger Ashby

name: The Smith's Request
description: Smith Torva forges with the lightning that hits the Steelspine. Something keeps stealing her iron.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: My iron's gone. Again. And there are little shell marks all over the floor.
intro.name: Smith Torva

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A beetle trundles away with a horseshoe on its back.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A ferret, fur on end, is hiding in the charcoal.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: My iron's back. Mostly. One horseshoe has a bite out of it.
outro.name: Smith Torva

name: The Howling Pass
description: The Thunder Hounds howl every time lightning strikes, and it strikes every few seconds.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: I haven't slept in a week. The howling. THE HOWLING.
intro.name: Smith Torva

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A hound throws back its head and howls as lightning cracks overhead.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A wolf in bucket armor joins the chorus.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Quiet. Beautiful quiet. I could cry.
outro.name: Smith Torva

choice.prompt: The smallest Thunder Hound sits down and looks up at you, sparks fizzing in its fur.

options.label: Give it a pat

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Zap. Your hair stands on end for the rest of the day. The hound follows you home, then wanders off, happy.

options.label: Teach it to howl into Torva's lightning rod

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Its howl rings through the rod and charges the forge. Torva is delighted.

name: Blades of the Sky
description: Iron Hawks have been diving at anything shiny. Torva is very shiny.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: They took my best hammer. Who takes a hammer? A bird took a hammer.
intro.name: Smith Torva

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A hawk with knife-feathers screeches overhead.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Another hawk drops a beetle on you, on purpose.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: My hammer! Look, it's barely dented.
outro.name: Smith Torva

name: The Lightning Lynx
description: Something faster than lightning prowls the high ridges. Torva wants one of its whiskers for her forge.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The ridge crackles. Fur and scrap metal everywhere.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: You're slow. Everyone's slow.
intro.name: Lightning Lynx

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A silver lynx appears out of nowhere, ears crackling with lightning.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: One whisker. That's all I needed. Now, about the dragon at the top.
outro.name: Smith Torva

choice.prompt: The Lightning Lynx offers you a race up the mountain instead of a fight.

options.label: Race it

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You lose, of course. But your dragon gives it a good run, and the lynx drops a crackling claw as a prize.

options.label: Trade it a polished bolt for a whisker

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It loves the shiny bolt. You get a whisker and the lynx's respect.

name: Ferrovane
description: At the top of the Steelspine sleeps Ferrovane, the oldest steel-scaled dragon. The lightning is her heartbeat.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Be polite. She's older than the mountain. Bring her something shiny. No, not my hammer.
intro.name: Smith Torva

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The last guards of the peak bar the way.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Another young dragon. How lovely. Let us see if you are worth the climb.
intro.name: Ferrovane

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A huge dragon of polished steel unfolds on the summit, sparks crackling along her horns.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Ferrovane folds her wings and lowers her head to your dragon. Two dragons, one very young and one very old, sit together in the storm for a long time.
outro.name: Smith Torva

name: The Lost Hats
description: Captain Wynn sails a skyship between the isles. Something keeps stealing her crew's hats.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Every hat on my ship is gone. Every one! A sailor without a hat is just a person on a boat.
intro.name: Captain Wynn

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A little whirlwind spins past, wearing four hats at once.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Something long and sparkling slides out of a cloud, a feathered hat on its head.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Hats! Hats everywhere! The crew is so happy. Have this, with my thanks.
outro.name: Captain Wynn

name: Moths in the Sails
description: Sunwing Moths have found the ship. They think the sails are the most delicious thing in the sky.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: My sails! They're eating my sails! In broad daylight!
intro.name: Captain Wynn

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A moth as big as a sail flutters down and takes a bite out of the mainsail.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A Prism Hawk dives in, hoping for a moth snack. It doesn't mind which side it's on.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The sails are full of holes, but they still fly. Mostly they whistle now.
outro.name: Captain Wynn

choice.prompt: The smallest Sunwing Moth lands on your dragon's nose and won't let go.

options.label: Give it the ship's old lamp

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It curls around the lamp and glows with joy. Wynn gives you a crate from the hold for being kind.

options.label: Shoo it off into the sun

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It flies straight up into the sunlight and drops a glittering scale as it goes.

name: The Ram Stampede
description: A herd of Cloud Rams is stampeding across the isles, and every step comes with thunder.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: They're running toward the market island. The market is made of glass.
intro.name: Captain Wynn

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A ram of dark cloud lowers its head. Lightning crackles between its horns.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The wind picks up behind the herd, pushing them faster.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The market is safe. Well, one window broke. It was already a bit cracked.
outro.name: Captain Wynn

name: The Sunscale Griffin
description: A griffin has built its nest on the highest island, right on top of the lighthouse.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The lighthouse island is crowded with feathers and sparks.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: This is MY tower. It is the shiniest tower. I am the shiniest bird. Go away.
intro.name: Sunscale Griffin

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A griffin with feathers like polished gold spreads its wings across the lighthouse lamp.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: The lighthouse shines again. Ships can find the isles at night. Now, about that whale.
outro.name: Captain Wynn

choice.prompt: The griffin asks to keep one corner of the lighthouse for its nest.

options.label: Let it share the tower

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It folds its wings and keeps watch beside the lamp. It drops a golden feather for you.

options.label: Let it stay if it keeps the lamp polished

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It agrees, very seriously. The keepers pay you for the free cleaning.

name: Aurelith
description: The isles are drifting apart. Aurelith, the great sky whale who carries them, is shaking them off its back.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: She's never done this before. Something has her upset. Go and find out. Gently, if you can.
intro.name: Captain Wynn

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The last guards of the high wind circle around you.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Too heavy... too many... I want to SWIM.
intro.name: Aurelith

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The clouds part. A whale the size of an island rolls toward you, thunder rumbling in her belly.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Aurelith settles. She hums a long, deep note that you feel in your bones, and the islands drift gently back together. Wynn's crew cheers so loudly they lose their hats again.
outro.name: Captain Wynn

name: The Falling Stars
description: Stargazer Ilo counts the stars over the rift. Lately the stars have been falling, and they are not happy about it.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Twelve stars fell last night. Twelve! I had names for all of them.
intro.name: Stargazer Ilo

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A tiny star bounces across the ground, sizzling with temper.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A jellyfish drifts out of the rift, its little moons spinning faster as it sees you.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: You calmed them. I'll help them back up, one at a time. It's a long ladder.
outro.name: Stargazer Ilo

name: The Empty Dogs
description: Null Hounds have been sniffing around the observatory. Where they walk, things go missing.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: My telescope is gone. My chair is gone. Half my sandwich is gone. Only half!
intro.name: Stargazer Ilo

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Something dog-shaped and empty pads out from behind the observatory, wagging nothing.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A coat with nobody in it floats along behind, sleeves full of telescope.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Everything is back. Except the sandwich. I don't want to know.
outro.name: Stargazer Ilo

choice.prompt: The last Null Hound sits and looks at you. Something in the emptiness looks sad.

options.label: Give it a name

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You call it Nothing. It wags so hard it almost becomes something. Ilo shares a bundle of supplies with you.

options.label: Throw a stick into the rift

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It bounds after the stick into the dark and comes back with a glittering crystal instead.

name: The Comet Race
description: Comet Lizards are racing in circles around the rift, and every lap cracks it a little wider.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: If they keep this up, the rift will be big enough to fall into. I don't want to fall into it.
intro.name: Stargazer Ilo

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A lizard streaks past in a blur of sparkles, then turns around for another lap.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A star mote hitches a ride on the next lizard's tail.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: They've stopped. The rift is closing up a bit. You can almost hear it sigh.
outro.name: Stargazer Ilo

name: The Gloam Stalker
description: Something hunts in the dark between the stars. Ilo has only ever seen its eyes.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The stars go out one by one as you walk.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: You can see me. Nobody sees me. That's rude.
intro.name: Gloam Stalker

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Two eyes open in the dark ahead. Then the dark stands up, and it's shaped like a very large cat.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: It's gone back into the dark. I think it was only lonely. Now there's only her.
outro.name: Stargazer Ilo

choice.prompt: The Gloam Stalker comes back and rubs against your dragon, purring like distant thunder.

options.label: Let it walk with you a while

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It pads beside you to the edge of the rift and leaves one of its whiskers behind, cold as night.

options.label: Ask it to show you the hidden paths

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It leads you to an old stash of starlight trinkets. Ilo buys them for her collection.

name: Nyxaris
description: At the heart of the rift waits Nyxaris, the dragon of starlight and nothing. The rift is tearing because she is.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: She's very old and very tired. Be kind. But be ready.
intro.name: Stargazer Ilo

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The last shadows of the rift gather to bar your way.

intro.speaker: npc
intro.text: Light, then dark. Dark, then light. I have held them apart so long. Show me you can hold on too.
intro.name: Nyxaris

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: A great dragon unfolds from the rift. One wing is full of stars. The other is not there at all, and yet it moves.

outro.speaker: npc
outro.text: Nyxaris folds both wings, the bright one and the empty one, and lowers her head. The rift stitches itself closed. Ilo counts every star in the sky, and for the first time in weeks, none of them fall.
outro.name: Stargazer Ilo
